items.headline: $STRK Explodes 322% in Four Weeks, Crushing BTC & ETH
items.summary: $STRK has ripped 322% in a month as Starknet's DeFi TVL climbs and a radical Layer 1 shift proposal keeps traders buzzing.

items.headline: $DATA Scores $30M Sui Bet as AI Protocol Migrates
items.summary: Sui Foundation is investing $30M into $DATA Network, which will retire its own chain and relaunch natively on Sui as an AI data protocol.

items.headline: Trader Nets $1.28M Moving $HYPE ETH Prices on Papertrade
items.summary: A trader pocketed $1.28M on new 1,000x-leverage exchange Papertrade by manipulating Hyperliquid's ETH price feeds — a wild oracle exploit on $HYPE's home turf.

items.headline: $SOPH Ditches zkSync, Rebuilds as Consumer Studio on Base
items.summary: $SOPH is shutting down its $60M node-sale zkSync chain after drawing under 200 daily users, pivoting to build consumer apps on Base.

items.headline: $CC Chain Tops All Blockchains With $60M Monthly Fees
items.summary: Canton Network, home of $CC, raked in $60.2M in fees over 30 days — outpacing Tron and Ethereum, per DefiLlama data.
